name: Song An
source:
Founder of the Web.
At the request of politicians, he has taken care of "troublemakers" such as those who threaten politicians with evidence of corruption, residents who refuse to be evicted for land development, and lawyers who support the residents.
He has managed Jing Ke, Cold Blood, Lan Yu, and others, and Luk was under his control for a time.
He was also a well-known owner of several racehorses and spent every week at the Happy Valley Racecourse watching the races.
He was shot and killed by Yvet while watching the race.
